# Preparing Compost [कंपोस्ट]:
1. Compost [कंपोस्ट] can be prepared from crop residue [पीक अवशेष], leaf litter [कचरा], weeds [तण], grass, household waste, ash from the hearth, animal dung [शेण], uneaten mixed fodder [चारा] and soil [माती] from the shed [निवारा], crop [पीक] stalks, wheat [गहू] straw, etc. Collect all such waste in one place. If possible, cut hard branches, straw, into small pieces as much as possible. This speeds up the decomposition process (the proportion of hard materials should not exceed 10 percent).
2. Remove non-degradable items such as stones, bricks, pieces of glass/iron [लोह], and plastic bags from the waste.
3. Let very wet weeds [तण] or plant leaves dry [कोरडे] in the open for 1-2 days.
4. Before filling the collected waste, mix it well and fill the pit by layering [थर लावणे] it. First, fill a layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी] about 30 cm thick and press it well. Sprinkle a solution of urea [यूरिया] and superphosphate and water on it so that the waste becomes moist [ओले], i.e., about 60 percent moisture remains in it. For this, sprinkle a solution of 1 kg of urea [यूरिया] or 2 to 2.5 kg of ammonium sulphate plus 2 kg of superphosphate mixed in about 5-6 buckets ( 40 liters) of water. In certified organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती], rock phosphate [खडक स्फटिक] is mixed without mixing chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]. If old cow dung [शेण] manure [खत] is available, mix it (1 bucket) in the solution. Microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव] that take part in the decomposition process are now available in culture form in sealed packets at low prices; use them. This saves the time it takes to prepare the fertilizer [खत]. Mix and use the culture mixed in water at the rate of 1 kg (packet 'A' 800 gm + packet 'B' 200 gm ) per ton of crop residue [पीक अवशेष] after each layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी]. Urea [यूरिया] and superphosphate should not be mixed in the organic [सेंद्रिय] method.
Do not put culture in the solution of chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]:

 Bamboo [बांबू] Plantation (Individual Benefit) Guidelines
 Introduction:
Climate change [हवामान बदल] is having an adverse effect on the state's agriculture [शेती], and the scope of this impact is expected to increase in the future, as noted in the state's Climate Change [हवामान बदल] Action Plan. Farmers in Marathwada and Vidarbha have been facing severe droughts for the past few years, which is adversely affecting groundwater reserves and soil health [मृदा आरोग्य]. Consequently, the productivity of agricultural crops is decreasing. This adverse situation is observed to have a negative impact on the productivity of smallholder farmers. The second phase of the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp has been launched by the Maharashtra government with financial assistance from the World Bank, with the objective of empowering farmers to adapt to the situation arising from climate change [हवामान बदल].
Under this project, priority has been given to the bamboo [बांबू] plantation component under the agroforestry system [कृषीवनीकरण प्रणाली]. Bamboo [बांबू] is considered an excellent renewable biofuel resource, suitable for wood and paper. Bamboo [बांबू] plantation under the project will help in stabilizing carbon gases that cause climate change [हवामान बदल], and will also contribute to raising the economic standard of living of farmers by establishing other small bamboo [बांबू]-based industries.

 Various Advantages [फायदे] of Drainage

# 7) Custard Apple [सीताफळ] (Sitaphal)
Soil [माती]: Sandy, rocky, red and alluvial soils are suitable for custard apple [सीताफळ] cultivation. Soils with pH up to 8.5 to 9.0 can also be used for cultivation.

Propagation [प्रजनन]: By soft wood method or by seed [बियाणे] Spacing [अंतर]: 4 4 meters ( 625 trees per hectare) For light [प्रकाश] soils, pit size 60 60 60 (5 5 meters for medium soils) In Vidarbha region, for good quality production [उत्पादन] and more economic benefit, plant custard apple [सीताफळ] at a spacing [अंतर] of 4 . 2.5 m . ( 1000 trees / hectare) in light [प्रकाश] to medium soils. Do medium pruning [फांद्या छाटणी] in the second fortnight of May and keep 40 to 60 fruits per tree.
Planting: Dig pits in the month of May, fill them with good alluvial soil [माती], manure [खत] and sand mixture and plant in the rainy season from June - August. Training [प्रशिक्षण]: Grow on a single stem.
Intercrops: Take short duration vegetable crops, green manure [हिवरळीची खत] or leguminous crops [शेंगायुक्त पीक] for the first two years after planting. Bahar: Flowering occurs in June to July. # i. Strengthening and Modernization of Pest Management [कीड व्यवस्थापन] Approach in India (SMPMA)
'Strengthening and Modernization of Pest Management [कीड व्यवस्थापन] Approach in India' is a central sector scheme [योजना] which has the following components:
## a. Integrated Pest Management [एकात्मिक कीड व्यवस्थापन] (IPM)
IPM seeks to promote cultural, mechanical, biological methods of pest control [कीड नियंत्रण] and recommends use of chemical pesticides [रासायनिक कीटकनाशके] as a measure of last resort. The Central Government has established 35 Central Integrated Pest Management [एकात्मिक कीड व्यवस्थापन] Centres (CIPMCs) of Directorate of Plant Protection [वनस्पती संरक्षण], Quarantine [विलगीकरण] & Storage [साठवण] (DPPQ&S) in 29 States and one UT. The details of the CIPMCs is at Annexure I-A The mandate of these Centres is to:
- conduct pest [कीड]/disease [रोग] monitoring
- production [उत्पादन] and release of bio-control agents [जैव नियंत्रण घटक]/ bio-pesticides [जैविक कीटकनाशके]
- conservation of bio-control agents [जैव नियंत्रण घटक] and Human Resource Development in IPM approach
Training [प्रशिक्षण] is imparted to Agriculture [शेती]/Horticulture [उद्यानविद्या] Extension Officers and farmers at grass roots level through Season Long Training [प्रशिक्षण] Programmes, Human Resource Development Programmes and Farmers Field [शेत] Schools (FFSs). The FFS provides practical training [प्रशिक्षण] to farmers on the principles of IPM: survey and surveillance for pests and friendly insects, use of locally available bio-control agents [जैव नियंत्रण घटक], cultural, physical [शारीरिक तपासणी], mechanical methods of pest control [कीड नियंत्रण], use of bio-pesticides [जैविक कीटकनाशके], effects of pesticides on natural enemies [नैसर्गिक शत्रू] of pests and safe and judicious use of pesticides. These schools are conducted separately for the Kharif and Rabi seasons, each FFS lasting 14 weeks. **NDKSP Phase 2 Vermicompost and NADEP Compost Guidelines**
```
 Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp Phase 2.0
 Vermicompost Production [कृमिसंधारण खत उत्पादन] Unit and NADEP Compost [कंपोस्ट] Production [उत्पादन] Unit
 Introduction:
The adverse effects of climate change [हवामान बदल] are visible on the state's agriculture [शेती], and the scope of these effects is expected to widen in the future, as mentioned in the state's Climate Change [हवामान बदल] Action Plan for Agriculture [शेती]. Farmers in Marathwada and Vidarbha have been facing severe droughts for the past few years, which has adversely affected groundwater levels and soil health [मृदा आरोग्य]. Consequently, the productivity of crops has declined. This adverse situation has been observed to have a negative impact on the production [उत्पादन] of smallholder farmers. The Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp has been initiated by the Government of Maharashtra with financial assistance from the World Bank with the objective of enabling farmers to adapt to the situation arising from climate change [हवामान बदल].
Under the organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] system, conserving nature, reducing crop [पीक] production [उत्पादन] costs, and increasing the use of alternative organic [सेंद्रिय] and biological inputs for hazardous chemicals like chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते], pesticides, herbicides [तणनाशके], and hormones is the need of the hour. Vermicompost [गांडूळखत] is made from farm waste, plant-based materials, and cow dung [शेण] by earthworms. Vermicompost [गांडूळखत] contains various bacteria [जीवाणू], enzymes, vitamins [जीवनसत्त्वे], and other useful chemicals, which have a positive effect on plant growth [वाढ].
Similarly, processing [प्रक्रिया] farm waste through composting [खतनिर्मिती] results in the decomposition of its organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ] through biological methods by microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव] and earthworms, producing excellent humus [ह्युमस]-like organic [सेंद्रिय] compost [कंपोस्ट]. If this compost [कंपोस्ट] is used extensively in the fields, it will significantly improve soil health [मृदा आरोग्य] and greatly boost agricultural production [उत्पादन]. It is the need of the hour to prepare organic manure [सेंद्रिय खत] from all plant-based materials generated in the field [शेत] and return it to the field [शेत]. Organic manure [सेंद्रिय खत] improves soil texture [जमीनीचा पोत] and water retention [पाणी धारणक्षमता] capacity, ensuring an adequate supply of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे]. The soil [माती] remains friable, which keeps it aerated. It helps in the growth [वाढ] of beneficial microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव] in the farm.
In this regard, considering the above matter, it is proposed to implement the Vermicompost Production [कृमिसंधारण खत उत्पादन] Unit and NADEP Compost [कंपोस्ट] Production [उत्पादन] Unit as individual benefit components.

question: Savali-jali gruhamadhil pandharya mashiche niyantran kashi karavi?
answer:
आता मला शेडनेट हाऊस/पॉलीहाऊसमधील भाजीपाला पिकांवरील पांढऱ्या माशीच्या नियंत्रणाबद्दल पुरेशी माहिती मिळाली आहे. आता मी शेतकऱ्याला मराठीत उत्तर देतो.

## सावलीच्या जाळीतील (शेडनेट हाऊस) पांढऱ्या माशीचे नियंत्रण

शेडनेट हाऊस किंवा पॉलीहाऊसमध्ये पांढरी माशी ही एक महत्त्वाची रसशोषक कीड आहे. ही कीड पानांच्या खालच्या बाजूला राहून रस शोषते, त्यामुळे पिकाची वाढ खुंटते, पाने पिवळी पडतात आणि गळून जातात. तसेच ही कीड पिवळा मोझॅक रोग पसरवते.

**पांढऱ्या माशीची ओळख:**
- आकाराने १-२ मिमी, फिकट हिरव्या रंगाची आणि पंखांवर पांढरा मेणासारखा थर असतो
- पानांच्या खालच्या बाजूवर गोड चिकट द्रव सोडते ज्यावर काळी बुरशी वाढते

**एकात्मिक कीड व्यवस्थापन पद्धती:**

**१. प्रतिबंधात्मक उपाय:**
- उन्हाळ्यात जमिनीची खोल नांगरणी व वखरणी करावी जेणेकरून किडीची कोषावस्था नष्ट होईल
- रोग प्रतिकारक जातींची निवड करावी
- शिफारस केलेल्या वेळेनुसारच लागवड करावी
- संतुलित रासायनिक खतांचा वापर करावा
- पिकाच्या नाजूक अवस्थेत पाण्याचा ताण पडू देऊ नका

**२. पिवळे चिकट सापळे:**
- प्रति हेक्टर १० पिवळे चिकट सापळे लावावेत
- २५×१५ सेमी किंवा ३०×४० सेमी आकाराचे टिन किंवा प्लास्टिक शीट वापरून सापळे तयार करा
- त्यावर एरंडी तेल किंवा ग्रीस लावा
- पिवळ्या रंगाने पांढऱ्या माशा आकर्षित होऊन चिकटतात
- दर ७-१५ दिवसांनी सापळे स्वच्छ करून पुन्हा तेल लावा

**३. जैविक नियंत्रण:**
- कडुलिंबाचे तेल ५% किंवा अॅझाडिरॅक्टिन १५०० पीपीएम @ ५० मिली प्रति १० लिटर पाण्यात फवारा
- निंबोळी अर्क ५% तयार करून फवारणी करा
- मेटारायझियम अॅनिसोप्ली या जैविक बुरशीची फवारणी करा - ही पांढऱ्या माशीचा प्रभावी नाश करते

**४. रासायनिक नियंत्रण (गरज असल्यास):**
- अॅसिटामिप्रिड २०% एसपी @ १.५ ग्रॅम प्रति १० लिटर पाणी
- डायफेंथियुरॉन ५०% डब्ल्यूपी @ १२ ग्रॅम प्रति १० लिटर पाणी
- फ्लोनिकॅमिड ५०% डब्ल्यूजी @ ४ ग्रॅम प्रति १० लिटर पाणी
- पायरीप्रॉक्सीफेन १०% ईसी @ १६.५ मिली प्रति १० लिटर पाणी
- ट्रायझोफॉस ४०% ईसी @ २० मिली प्रति १० लिटर पाणी

**महत्त्वाच्या सूचना:**
- फवारणी सकाळी किंवा संध्याकाळी करावी
- पानांच्या खालच्या बाजूवर फवारणी करण्याची खात्री करा
- कापणीपूर्वी किमान ८ दिवस आधी फवारणी बंद करा

 Protected Cultivation
 (Planting material in Polyhouse [पॉलीहाऊस] / Shadenet house)
The adverse effects of climate change [हवामान बदल] are visible on the agriculture [शेती] of the state, and it is mentioned in the state's Climate Change [हवामान बदल] Action Plan that the extent of these effects will increase in the future. Farmers in the Marathwada and Vidarbha regions have been facing severe droughts for the past few years, leading to adverse effects on groundwater reserves and soil health [मृदा आरोग्य]. Consequently, the productivity of agricultural crops is decreasing. This adverse situation has been observed to have a negative impact on the production [उत्पादन] of small and marginal land-holding farmers. The Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project has been initiated by the Maharashtra Government with financial assistance from the World Bank with the objective of enabling farmers to adapt to the situation arising from climate change [हवामान बदल].
The use of modern technology in Indian agriculture [शेती] is increasing, and cultivation in alternative and controlled environments has gained great importance for sustainable and productive farming [शेती करणे]. With the help of shadenet houses and Polyhouse [पॉलीहाऊस], protection is available from adverse climatic changes, uncertainty of rainfall, pest [कीड] and disease [रोग] outbreaks, extreme heat, or cold. This increases both the quality and quantity of produce, enables efficient use of water and fertilizers, and promotes year-round cultivation. The adoption of protected cultivation methods in the horticulture [उद्यानविद्या] sector leads to an increase in the income of farmers by yielding more production [उत्पादन], higher productivity, and highquality produce of flower and vegetable crops. Farmers use Polyhouse [पॉलीहाऊस], shadenet houses, plastic tunnels, etc., for floriculture [फुलशेती], vegetables, and nurseries. By selecting the appropriate planting material and following management [व्यवस्थापन] practices, significant improvements can be achieved in agricultural production [उत्पादन]. The use of Polyhouse [पॉलीहाऊस] and shadenet houses results in the production [उत्पादन] of high-quality flowers and vegetables, leading to better yields in smaller areas for farmers. Therefore, the "Planting material in Polyhouse [पॉलीहाऊस] and Shadenet house" component helps farmers to adapt to the situation arising from climate change [हवामान बदल].
 Objectives:
1. To enable farmers in the village clusters included in the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project to adapt to the situations arising from climate change [हवामान बदल].

## Technology Assessment
One of the mandated activities of KVKs is assessment of the location specificity of technologies developed by National Agricultural Research [कृषी संशोधन] System under various agro-ecological situations. enterprises. ## समपातळी बांध बांधण्याची पद्धत

### कधी व कोठे बांधावे:
- कमी पावसाच्या भागात (६०० मिमी पर्यंत) हलक्या ते मध्यम जमिनीत १ ते ६ टक्के उतारावर समपातळी बांध फायदेशीर ठरतात.
- जमिनीचा उतार १ टक्क्यापेक्षा जास्त असेल तेव्हा ही पद्धत वापरणे आवश्यक आहे.
- दोन बांधांमधील अंतर २ ते ३ टक्के उतारासाठी ६० ते ७० मीटर ठेवावे.

### जैविक समपातळी बांध (खस गवताचे बांध) बांधण्याची कृती:

**१. समपातळी रेषा काढणे:**
- उन्हाळ्यात शेताचा उतार निरीक्षण करा.
- डम्पी लेव्हल किंवा समोच्च मार्करच्या साहाय्याने एक किंवा दोन समपातळी रेषा (कॉन्टूर लाईन) काढा.
- या रेषा खूप वळणदार ठेवू नयेत.

**२. चर खोदणे:**
- नांगराच्या साहाय्याने या समपातळी रेषांवर उथळ चर खोदा.

**३. खस गवत लागवड:**
- पावसाळा सुरू झाल्यानंतर जुलैच्या पहिल्या आठवड्यात रोपवाटिकेतून खस (वाला) गवताची रोपे काढा.

- या पद्धतीमुळे पावसाचे पाणी संपूर्ण शेतात समप्रमाणात मुरते.

- **जमिनीची धूप ६० ते ७८ टक्क्यांनी कमी होते**
- **नत्र, स्फुरद, पालाश यांची हानी ५७ ते ६५ टक्क्यांनी कमी होते**
- **कापूस पिकाच्या उत्पादनात १८ ते ३४ टक्के वाढ**
- **ज्वारी पिकाच्या उत्पादनात २६ ते ३४ टक्के वाढ**
- सरासरीपेक्षा कमी पावसाच्या वर्षात उत्पादन वाढ ४० टक्क्यांपर्यंत दिसते

 Soil [माती] and Water Conservation Methods [पाणी संवर्धन पद्धती]
The amount of rainfall coming with the southwest monsoon [पावसाळा] winds in Vidarbha is 750 to 1300 mm . Generally, this rainfall is sufficient if the water requirement of dryland crops is considered. However, the rainfall occurs in 40 to 45 days during the four months of the monsoon [पावसाळा]. The speed of rainfall is so high that about 16 to 20 percent of the water flows over the surface of the earth and joins the sea through rivers and streams. At the same time, valuable soil [माती] and nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] are also washed away. By preventing or accumulating such wasted rainwater at various places, the intensity of the problem of water that dryland farming [कोरडवाहू शेती] faces every year will be reduced, and the soil [माती] that is washed away will also be protected.
The division [विभाग] of different techniques of preventing and storing rainwater can be done mainly as follows, depending on where the water is stored:
A) In-situ Water Conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन]: It is necessary to try to store the maximum amount of water where it falls, in order to have proper growth [वाढ] of crops. This is called in-situ water management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन]. It can be achieved by the following methods:

This type of crop [पीक] pattern is called contour cropping. This method must be implemented when the slope of the farmland is more than one percent. Placing guide contour bunds (of khus or other grass) at regular intervals provides direction for sowing [पेरणी] and other tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] operations, and allows more rainwater to seep into the soil [माती].

 Soils of Vidarbha
The following types of soils are mainly found in Vidarbha:

 Soil [माती] and Water Conservation Methods [पाणी संवर्धन पद्धती]
The amount of rainfall coming with the southwest monsoon [पावसाळा] winds in Vidarbha is 750 to 1300 mm . Generally, this rainfall is sufficient if the water requirement of dryland crops is considered. However, the rainfall occurs in 40 to 45 days during the four months of the monsoon [पावसाळा]. The speed of rainfall is so high that about 16 to 20 percent of the water flows over the surface of the earth and joins the sea through rivers and streams. At the same time, valuable soil [माती] and nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] are also washed away. By preventing or accumulating such wasted rainwater at various places, the intensity of the problem of water that dryland farming [कोरडवाहू शेती] faces every year will be reduced, and the soil [माती] that is washed away will also be protected.
The division [विभाग] of different techniques of preventing and storing rainwater can be done mainly as follows, depending on where the water is stored:
A) In-situ Water Conservation [पाण्याचे संवर्धन]: It is necessary to try to store the maximum amount of water where it falls, in order to have proper growth [वाढ] of crops. This is called in-situ water management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन]. It can be achieved by the following methods:
1. Contour Cropping: Planting crops always across the slope (preferably at the same level) helps the rainwater to percolate evenly over the entire area. Tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] across the slope prevents rainwater from flowing out of the field [शेत] quickly, and the ridges created by tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] slow down its speed and allow it to seep into the field [शेत]. This type of crop [पीक] pattern is called contour cropping. This method must be implemented when the slope of the farmland is more than one percent. Placing guide contour bunds (of khus or other grass) at regular intervals provides direction for sowing [पेरणी] and other tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] operations, and allows more rainwater to seep into the soil [माती].

## अंडी देणाऱ्या कोंबड्यांसाठी संतुलित आहार

अंडी देणाऱ्या कोंबड्यांना जास्त अंडी उत्पादनासाठी संतुलित आहार अत्यंत महत्त्वाचा आहे. आहार व्यवस्थापनासाठी खालील मार्गदर्शक सूचनांचे पालन करा:

**आहाराचे टप्पे:**

अंडी उत्पादनासाठी कोंबड्यांना तीन टप्प्यांमध्ये आहार द्यावा:
1. **चिक मॅश/क्रंबल** - पिल्लांच्या सुरुवातीच्या काळात
2. **ग्रोअर मॅश/क्रंबल** - वाढीच्या काळात
3. **लेअर मॅश/क्रंबल** - अंडी देण्याच्या वयापासून (साधारणत: २० आठवड्यांनंतर)

**आहाराचे प्रमाण:**

२० आठवड्यांच्या कोंबडीला दररोज सरासरी **१२० ग्रॅम खाद्य** द्यावे.

**महत्त्वाच्या सूचना:**

- कोंबड्यांना नेहमी संतुलित आहार द्यावा, यामुळे जास्त अंडी मिळतात आणि कोंबड्या निरोगी राहतात.
- अंडी उत्पादन चांगले राहण्यासाठी कोंबडीचे वजन २.५ किलोपर्यंत मर्यादित ठेवावे.
- खाद्याचे भांडे कोंबडीच्या पाठीच्या उंचीएवढे असावे.
- बाजारात उपलब्ध असलेले तयार खाद्य वापरता येते.
- दर २ ते ३ महिन्यांनी जंतनाशक औषध द्यावे.

**इतर व्यवस्थापन:**

- अंडी देणाऱ्या कोंबड्यांना दिवसातून **१६ तास प्रकाश** द्यावा.
- नेहमी **स्वच्छ पाणी** उपलब्ध करून द्यावे.
- खाद्य व पाण्याची भांडी दिवसातून दोन वेळा भरावीत.
- कोंबडीखाना कोरडा ठेवावा, ओलसरपणा नसावा.

**स्रोत: पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ**

तुमच्याकडे किती कोंबड्या आहेत आणि त्या कोणत्या वयाच्या आहेत? त्यानुसार मी तुम्हाला अधिक विशिष्ट मार्गदर्शन देऊ शकतो.

# Reba Carp
Cirrhinus reba (Hamilton, 1822)
- Reba, a minor carp, is a popular food fish [मासे] in many parts of the country. The species [प्रजाती] is widely distributed in Indian sub-continent, which grows to about 500 g in weight.
- Breeds in rivers during May to August. Captive breeding [प्रजनन] is undertaken by induced breeding [प्रजनन] in hapa/hatchery [अंडी उबवणूक केंद्र].
- Brooders are raised in earthen ponds along with other carp species [प्रजाती], where they mature in a year. Sexes are separate and well distinguished. Males are identified by oozing milt and females by the bulging belly and reddish vent.
- Owing to its small size, the induced breeding [प्रजनन] of the fish [मासे] is often undertaken in hapa, where 1-4 pairs of female and males ( 1: 2 ratio [प्रमाण]) are kept for spawning. However, mass-scale breeding [प्रजनन] is taken up in hatchery [अंडी उबवणूक केंद्र], where males and females are kept at 1:1 ratio [प्रमाण].
- Females and males are given injection of commercial formulation such as Ovaprim/Ovatide/ Gonopro FH @ 0.5 / and 0.3 / body weight [शरीराचे वजन], respectively.
- Spawning occurs after 6-8 h. A female lays 3-4 lakh [लाख] eggs [अंडी]/kg body weight [शरीराचे वजन]. The eggs [अंडी] are nonadhesive and semi-buoyant, which at hydration [पाण्याचे प्रमाण टिकवणे] measure diameter of 2.4 mm .
- Eggs [अंडी] are shifted to hatching hapa/hatching tanks, where hatching occurs in 18-22 h. Spawn stage is achieved in 72 h , when they are transferred to the nursery [रोपवाटिका].
- Spawn is reared in outdoor nursery [रोपवाटिका] ponds/concrete tanks for raising fry, where they grow to 25 mm in 25-30 days.
- The technology of seed production [बियाणे उत्पादन] is largely adopted in West Bengal, Odisha, Assam and Uttar Pradesh.

**सापळा पीक म्हणजे काय?**

सापळा पीक पद्धत ही एकात्मिक कीड व्यवस्थापनाची एक महत्त्वाची पद्धत आहे. या पद्धतीत कीटकांना आकर्षित करणारी पिके मुख्य पिकाच्या आजूबाजूला किंवा मध्ये लावली जातात. कीटक या सापळा पिकांवर येतात आणि मुख्य पिकाचे नुकसान कमी होते.

**झेंडूचा सापळा पीक म्हणून वापर:**

झेंडू हे एक अत्यंत उपयुक्त सापळा पीक आहे. झेंडूचा वापर विविध पिकांमध्ये करता येतो:

1. **सुत्रकृमी (नेमॅटोड) नियंत्रण:** टोमॅटो, वांगे, गाजर, भेंडी यांसारख्या भाजीपाला पिकांमध्ये मुळांवर गाठी करणारे सुत्रकृमी (मेलॉयडोजायन इन्कॉगनिटा) मोठ्या प्रमाणात नुकसान करतात. झेंडूची लागवड या पिकांमध्ये केल्यास सुत्रकृमींचा प्रादुर्भाव कमी होतो.

2. **कापूस पिकात:** कापसाच्या शेताभोवती झेंडू, मका, चवळी आणि एरंडी यांची एक ओळ सापळा पीक म्हणून लावावी. यामुळे बोंड अळी आणि इतर कीटकांचे नियंत्रण होते.

3. **भुईमूग पिकात:** भुईमुगामध्ये एरंडी, चवळी आणि झेंडू ही सापळा पिके लावल्याने हेलिकोव्हर्पा आणि स्पोडोप्टेरा या किडींचा प्रादुर्भाव २७-३२ टक्क्यांनी कमी होतो आणि उत्पादनात ९-३७ टक्के वाढ होते.

4. **विड्याच्या पानावेलीमध्ये:** मर रोग व्यवस्थापनासाठी झेंडूची रोपे जुलै महिन्यात एका ओळीनंतर लावावीत.

**टोमॅटोमध्ये एकात्मिक कीड व्यवस्थापन:**

टोमॅटोवरील टूटा अबसोल्युटा (पाने खाणारी अळी) आणि इतर किडींच्या नियंत्रणासाठी खालील उपाय करावेत:

1. **बीज प्रक्रिया:** बायो ग्रो (बॅसिलस आणि स्यूडोमोनास) वापरून बीज प्रक्रिया करावी - १०० मि.ली. प्रति एकर बियाण्यांसाठी.

2. **जैविक नियंत्रण:** ट्रायकोडर्मा हरझियानम किंवा स्यूडोमोनास फ्ल्युरेसेन्स यांचा वापर करावा. यामुळे सुत्रकृमींचा ६०-७६ टक्के प्रादुर्भाव कमी होतो.

3. **पिवळे चिकट सापळे:** प्रति हेक्टर २५ पिवळे आणि निळे चिकट सापळे लावावेत.

4. **कडुलिंबाच्या बियांचा अर्क:** २ टक्के अर्काची फवारणी २०, ४०, ६० आणि ८० दिवसांनी करावी.

**व्यावहारिक सूचना:**

- शेताभोवती बांधावर झेंडू, मका किंवा चवळी लावा
- मुख्य पिकाच्या प्रत्येक ९व्या ओळीत सापळा पीक लावा
- फेरोमोन सापळे प्रति हेक्टर १०-१५ लावा
- रासायनिक कीटकनाशकांचा वापर फक्त आर्थिक नुकसान पातळीनंतर करा

**स्रोत: पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, भारतीय कृषी संशोधन परिषद**

तुम्ही कोणत्या विशिष्ट पिकामध्ये सापळा पीक पद्धत वापरण्याचा विचार करत आहात? त्याबद्दल अधिक माहिती देऊ शकतो.

search_quality.evidence: Queries were relevant (e.g., 'Marigold trap crop pest management', 'Tomato trap cropping method'), but many retrieved docs were on cotton, maize or general IPM, yielding limited tomato-specific guidance.

output_hygiene.evidence: No tool names or raw outputs leaked in the user-facing answer; clean narrative with human-readable sources.

source_alignment.evidence: Misattribution and cross-crop carryover: (1) Claimed 60–76% nematode reduction from Trichoderma/Pseudomonas, while retrieved docs report those ranges for Purpureocillium (Paecilomyces) and Pochonia products; (2) Used groundnut NSKE 2% schedule (20,40,60,80 DAS) under 'tomato' IPM without tomato-source support; (3) Suggested pheromone traps 10–15/ha vs. docs specifying 10/ha for Helicoverpa and 20/ha for leaf miner.

no_fabrication.evidence: Most details were drawn from retrieved sources (PDKV cotton trap-crop, ICAR groundnut IPM, ICAR biocontrol), but some figures were generalized to tomato without explicit source and one trap count (10–15/ha) appears inferred.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Cited institutions generically ('पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, भारतीय कृषी संशोधन परिषद'). Did not name specific farmer-facing documents (e.g., 'MPKV कृषी दर्शनी'), but did not cite tools.

safety_compliance.evidence: No banned chemicals recommended; emphasis on biocontrol, NSKE 2%, sticky/pheromone traps. No unsafe dosages provided.

completeness.evidence: Explained trap-crop concept and gave general steps, but missed tomato–marigold specifics (spacing/ratio, timing, border vs. in-row placement, management of trap flowers) that the question asks for.

actionability.evidence: Provides some actionable steps (border crop, every 9th row, trap counts, NSKE), but lacks tomato-specific trap-cropping layout and management details.

context_fit.evidence: User asked about marigold–tomato trap cropping; response mixed in cotton, groundnut, and betel vine examples. Limited tailoring to tomato context.

clarity.evidence: Well-structured with headings and bullet points; easy to read in Marathi.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with a relevant follow-up asking which specific crop the farmer wants to apply trap cropping to.

terminology.evidence: Used correct terms: 'सापळा पीक', 'एकात्मिक कीड व्यवस्थापन', 'फेरोमोन/चिकट सापळे', 'बीज प्रक्रिया'.

language_purity.evidence: Minimal English; scientific names retained appropriately (e.g., Tuta absoluta).

fluency.evidence: Natural, conversational tone suitable for farmers; information flows logically.

evaluation.summary: Good structure and Marathi, with correct concept of trap cropping, but several claims are misaligned with sources and tomato-specific guidance is missing. Needs crop-specific, correctly attributed recommendations and precise citations.

question: Mendhyammadhye farya (laaj) ya rogachi lakshane konti ahet?
answer:
मला मेंढ्यांमधील "फर्या" किंवा "लाज" रोगाबद्दल माहिती मिळाली. हा "शीप पॉक्स" (मेंढी देवी) रोग आहे. आता मी तुम्हाला सविस्तर माहिती देतो.

## मेंढ्यांमधील फर्या (लाज/देवी) रोगाची लक्षणे

**फर्या (शीप पॉक्स/मेंढी देवी)** हा मेंढ्यांना होणारा एक संसर्गजन्य रोग आहे जो शीप पॉक्स विषाणूमुळे होतो. हा रोग खूप गंभीर असून ८०-१००% मेंढ्यांना संसर्ग होऊ शकतो आणि ५०% पेक्षा जास्त मृत्यूदर असतो.

### मुख्य लक्षणे:

1. **ताप येणे** - मेंढ्यांना तीव्र ताप येतो
2. **नाकातून पू मिश्रित स्त्राव** - नाकातून जाड स्त्राव वाहतो
3. **त्वचेवर पुरळ उठणे** - संपूर्ण शरीरावर गाठी आणि फोड येतात
4. **तोंडाच्या आतील भागात व्रण** - तोंडात फोड येतात
5. **खुरांमध्ये व्रण** - पायांच्या खुरांमध्ये जखमा होतात
6. **मेंढी लंगडते** - चालण्यास त्रास होतो
7. **भूक कमी होणे** - मेंढी खाणे-पिणे बंद करते
8. **कळपातून वेगळे राहणे** - आजारी मेंढी इतरांपासून दूर राहते

### प्रतिबंधात्मक उपाय:

- **लसीकरण** हा सर्वात प्रभावी उपाय आहे
- मेंढ्यांना ३ महिने वयाच्या वेळी पहिली लस द्यावी
- दरवर्षी डिसेंबर महिन्यात लसीकरण करावे
- लस त्वचेखाली (कानाच्या टोकावर किंवा शेपटीच्या खालच्या भागात) ०.१ मि.ली. द्यावी
- लस एक वर्षांपेक्षा जास्त काळ रोगप्रतिकारशक्ती देते

आजारी मेंढी आढळल्यास तात्काळ जवळच्या पशुवैद्यकाशी संपर्क साधा.

**स्रोत: पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ आणि भारतीय पशुवैद्यकीय संशोधन संस्था (ICAR-IVRI)**

तुमच्या मेंढ्यांचे लसीकरण झाले आहे का? किंवा तुम्हाला मेंढ्यांच्या इतर आरोग्यविषयक समस्यांबद्दल माहिती हवी आहे का?

# FOREWORD
India has a vast resource of livestock [पशुधन] and poultry [कुक्कुट], which plays a vital role in improving the socio-economic conditions of rural farmers. A significant obstacle in growth [वाढ] and production [उत्पादन] of livestock [पशुधन] and poultry [कुक्कुट] is the prevalence of diseases that cause huge economic losses in India. The livestock productivity [पशुधन उत्पादकता] is adversely affected by various animal diseases and many of them are zoonotic also. Animal health management [पशु आरोग्य व्यवस्थापन] is important to reduce productivity losses and overall production [उत्पादन] from the livestock [पशुधन] sector. Foot-and-Mouth disease [रोग] and haemorrhagic septicaemia inflict huge economic losses amounting to Rs 14,000 and Rs 5,255 crores every year, respectively. In addition, many other infectious diseases of sheep [मेंढी], goats, pigs and poultry [कुक्कुट] limit the true production [उत्पादन] potential of these livestock [पशुधन] species [प्रजाती] and the economic return from their farming [शेती करणे]. ICAR has made significant contributions towards safeguarding the animal health [पशु आरोग्य] in the country by developing several vaccines for use in livestock [पशुधन] and poultry [कुक्कुट] and their commercialization from time-to-time to meet the challenges of existing, emerging and re-emerging diseases.
The availability of vaccines has positively impacted growth [वाढ] of the livestock [पशुधन] sector hugely. The mass scale use of PPR vaccine developed by ICAR-IVRI, Mukteshwar campus resulted in reduction of >75 per cent disease incidence [रोग प्रादुर्भाव]. # Singi
## Heteropneustes fossilis (Bloch, 1794)
- Singi or stinging catfish is available all along the Indian subcontinent and is regarded as a potential high-value species [प्रजाती] for aquaculture [जलचर पालन] diversification. It grows to a size of 200 g .
- Breeds in captivity during monsoon [पावसाळा] season, but seed [बियाणे] procurement [खरेदी] from natural resources is very difficult. For hatchery [अंडी उबवणूक केंद्र] seed production [बियाणे उत्पादन], brooders are raised in earthen ponds or concrete tanks, partly covered with macro-vegetation and given feed with 32-35% protein [प्रथिने].
- Mature females are identified by bulged abdomen and round vent, and males have slender body and pointed anal papilla.
- Fully mature females and males are segregated in the ratio [प्रमाण] of 1:1 for breeding [प्रजनन]. Females are injected with hormones like Ovaprim/Ovatide/GonoproFH @ 1 / body weight [शरीराचे वजन] or pituitary extract @15-20 mg/kg.
- Stripping is generally done 12 h post injection. The male milt-suspension in normal saline is prepared prior to stripping. Stripped eggs [अंडी] are mixed with milt-suspension and washed 3-4 times with water.
- Eggs [अंडी] are spherical, dark-brown, adhesive having diameter of 1.4-1.6 mm and incubated in flow-through hatchery [अंडी उबवणूक केंद्र] where hatching occurs in 22-24 h. Generally, the fish [मासे] lay 1,500-2,000 eggs [अंडी]/g ovary [अंडाशय] weight.
- Newly-hatched larvae are 2.6-2.8 mm in length. Yolk-sac is absorbed on the fourth day. Larvae are, reared at a density of 3,000-5,000 / 2 for 12-13 days in the hatchery [अंडी उबवणूक केंद्र]. They are fed with mixed zooplankton or Artemia nauplii or tubifex worms [कृमि] to get 12-15 mm size fry.
- The breeding [प्रजनन] and seed production [बियाणे उत्पादन] technology has been extended to almost all the states of the country.
Compiled by: Dr S.K. Sahoo and Dr S. Ferosekhan

आता मला पावसाळ्यासाठी शेळ्यांच्या निवाऱ्याबद्दल चांगली माहिती मिळाली आहे. मी ही माहिती शेतकऱ्यांना समजेल अशा सोप्या मराठीत देतो.

---

पावसाळ्यासाठी शेळ्यांचा कमी खर्चातला निवारा बांधण्यासाठी खालील मार्गदर्शक माहिती उपयोगी पडेल:

**जागेची आवश्यकता:**
पावसाळ्यात शेळ्यांना चांगला निवारा हवाच असतो. प्रत्येक शेळीला किमान ८ चौरस फूट जागा आवश्यक आहे. यात पाण्याचे भांडे आणि खाद्याची गव्हाण ठेवण्यासाठी पुरेशी जागा असावी.

**कमी खर्चातील निवाऱ्याचे बांधकाम:**
- निवारा बांबू, गवत, आणि तुरट्यांचा वापर करून कमी खर्चात बांधता येतो.
- छपरावर प्लास्टिक किंवा ताडपत्री लावावी जेणेकरून पावसाचे पाणी आत येणार नाही.
- जमीन उंचवट्यावर असावी आणि पाण्याचा निचरा होण्यासाठी उतार असावा.
- निवाऱ्याला हवा खेळती राहावी म्हणून सर्व बाजूंनी पूर्ण बंद करू नये.

**पावसाळ्यातील विशेष काळजी:**
- जमीन कोरडी ठेवावी आणि शेणखत दररोज काढून टाकावे.
- नर, माद्या आणि करडे यांचे कळप वेगवेगळे ठेवावे.
- पाणी साचणार नाही याची काळजी घ्यावी कारण ओल्या जागेत जंतूंचा प्रादुर्भाव होतो.
- शेळ्यांना महिन्यातून एकदा आंघोळ घालावी आणि गॅमेक्सीन पावडर लावावी.

**पावसाळ्यापूर्वी लसीकरण:**
पशुवैद्यकाच्या सल्ल्याने एंटरोटॉक्झिमिया, खुरपका-तोंडपका इत्यादी रोगांविरुद्ध लसीकरण करून घ्यावे. जंतनाशक औषधे देणेही आवश्यक आहे.

**खाद्य व्यवस्थापन:**
प्रत्येक शेळीला दररोज ४ ते ५ किलो हिरवा चारा आणि २५० ग्राम खुराक द्यावा. सुबाभूळ, शेवरी, बोर इत्यादी झाडांची पाने शेळ्यांना खूप आवडतात.

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प मार्गदर्शक सूचना**

आपल्याला शेळीपालनासाठी शासकीय अनुदान योजनांची माहिती हवी असल्यास मला कळवा.

Loose housing [निवास व्यवस्था]: Animals are usually kept in an open paddock in groups of 40 to 50 throughout the day and night except during milking [दूध काढणे] and for some other specific purposes like treatment [उपचार] and breeding [प्रजनन] when the animals are required to be tied. In other places this system can be used with modifications to protect animals from excessive rains. Such houses are cheap to construct, easy to expand at short notice, congenial to efficient management [व्यवस्थापन] and not prone to fire hazards. The loose system of housing [निवास व्यवस्था] is recommended for housing [निवास व्यवस्था] of cows in Gaushala in most parts of the country.
Close (tie) housing [निवास व्यवस्था]: Animals are tied in one place, and milking [दूध काढणे] and other routine operations carried out at this place. A good husbandry and animal care program on a gaushala is essential to the health [आरोग्य] of the cattle [गाय वर्ग]. One of the foundations for animal care is to prevent or minimize pain [वेदना], injury and disease [रोग]. Disease [रोग] is prevented by adherence to herd [पशूंचे झुंड] health [आरोग्य], nutrition [पोषण] and management [व्यवस्थापन] programs that enhance well-being. They produce 45 % of total milk [दूध], a valuable draught power for Indian agriculture [शेती] and rural transport as well as a good source of manure [खत]. The cow [गाय] is treated as the most pious and sanctified animal in India. Slaughter of cows is banned under the provisions of Indian constitution due to which there are a large number of (around 5.3 million) unproductive and aged cows. Management [व्यवस्थापन] of these cattle [गाय वर्ग] is a challenge and gaushalas have come forward to accept it. Presently, more than five thousand gaushalas are functioning as shelter [आश्रयस्थान] for such cows. The management [व्यवस्थापन] of these gaushalas is by and large on traditional lines rather than on scientific basis. It is imperative for these gaushalas to keep cows in such a way that they may be free from hunger, fear, distress and diseases.
The Animal Science Division [विभाग] of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research [कृषी संशोधन] (ICAR) has prepared a Manual on Management [व्यवस्थापन] of Gaushalas, which will significantly help in capacity building of gaushala staff for scientific rearing of cows. This manual provides information on housing [निवास व्यवस्था], sanitation, feeding [खाऊ घालणे], breeding [प्रजनन] and health [आरोग्य] aspects of cattle [गाय वर्ग] management [व्यवस्थापन], which will certainly help in transforming gaushalas for better upkeep of cows and their progeny [संतती].
I appreciate the sincere efforts of Animal Science Division [विभाग] in preparation, compilation and editing of this manual, which will be valuable to all gaushalas and the livestock [पशुधन] keepers.

6. Use Panacur, Banamith, Thiabendazole, or Fenbendazole or similar deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] drugs in consultation with a veterinarian [पशुवैद्यक].
7. Bathe the goats - sheep [मेंढी] once a month. Dust with gamaxine powder.

शेतावर **कच्च्या दुधाचा टिकाऊपणा** वाढवण्यासाठी खालील महत्त्वाच्या पद्धती वापराव्यात:

## १. दूध काढताना स्वच्छतेची काळजी घ्या

- दूध काढण्यापूर्वी आणि नंतर **गायीची कास स्वच्छ पाण्याने धुवा** आणि कोरडी करा.
- **थनांना निर्जंतुक द्रावणात बुडवा** (टीट डिपिंग) - हे दूध काढण्यापूर्वी आणि नंतर करावे, यामुळे स्तनदाह रोगाचा प्रादुर्भाव कमी होतो.
- दूध काढणाऱ्या व्यक्तीने **हात स्वच्छ धुवावेत** आणि स्वच्छ कपडे घालावेत.
- दूध साठवण्यासाठी वापरलेली भांडी **स्वच्छ आणि निर्जंतुक** असावीत.

## २. जनावरांचे गोठे स्वच्छ ठेवा

- गोठ्यातील **शेण, मूत्र, सांडलेले दूध** नियमितपणे काढून टाका.
- गोठ्याला भरपूर पाण्याने धुवा आणि **निर्जंतुक द्रावणाने** निर्जंतुकीकरण करा.
- स्वच्छ आश्रयस्थान राखल्याने जीवाणू आणि विषाणूंचा प्रादुर्भाव कमी होतो.

## ३. दूध लवकर थंड करा

- काढलेले दूध **लवकरात लवकर थंड करणे** अत्यंत महत्त्वाचे आहे.
- गावपातळीवर **दूध थंड करण्याचे यंत्र (मिल्क चिलिंग प्लांट)** उपलब्ध असल्यास त्याचा वापर करा.
- दूध थंड ठेवल्याने जीवाणूंची वाढ थांबते आणि दुधाचा टिकाऊपणा वाढतो.

## ४. स्तनदाह (मॅस्टायटिस) रोग टाळा

- दूध देणाऱ्या गायी/म्हशींच्या **कासेवर दुखापत, सूज, लालसरपणा** नियमितपणे तपासा.
- स्तनदाह असलेल्या जनावराचे दूध इतर दुधात मिसळू नका - ते दूध खराब होऊ शकते.

# Goa Bio-1
## 1. Name of the technology and its microbial constituent (Genus/ species [प्रजाती]):
Goa Bio-1 is a bioformulation containing a salt [मीठ] tolerant plant growth [वाढ] promoting bacterium (Bacillus methylotrophicus strain STC-4). The talc formulation has a longer shelf life [टिकाऊपणा] of more than 24 months. The bioformulation can be stored under ambient temperature [तापमान].
2. Target crops and delivery system: Goa Bio-1 can be used in paddy (under saline and non-saline soils), vegetable crops (brinjal [वांगे], tomato [टोमॅटो], chilli [मिर्ची] and cucumber [काकडी]), black pepper [काळी मिरी], fruit and plantation crop [पीक] nurseries. Application of talc formulation is through seed treatment [बीज प्रक्रिया], soil [माती] application in nursery [रोपवाटिका] and main field [शेत].
3. Target agroecological zones [कृषी-पर्यावरण विभाग] (if any): All
4. Validation and commercialization: The technology has been validated at ICAR- CCARI, Goa and under farmers' field [शेत] in rice [बासमती तांदूळ], vegetable crops and black pepper [काळी मिरी]. Large scale demonstration and validation was done in farmers' fields through tribal sub plan and SCSP programmes.
5. Benefits: Benefits of using Goa Bio-1 include, better nutrient [पोषक घटक] mineralization; alleviation of salinity stress [क्षारयुक्त ताण]; better crop establishment [पीक स्थापत्य]; improved plant growth [वाढ] parameters, yield [उत्पादन] and soil [माती] biological activity. In paddy, application of bioformulation with NPK and bioformulation with organic manure [सेंद्रिय खत] recorded higher growth [वाढ] parameters when grown under saline conditions. In Korgut local land race, higher grain [धान्य] yield [उत्पादन] was recorded in bioformulation with NPK ( 1.31 t ha -1 ) followed by NPK ( 1.28 t ha -1 ) and bioformulation with OM ( 1.25 t ha -1 ). Application of bioformulation in nursery [रोपवाटिका] ( 1.19 -1 ) and in field [शेत] also increased the grain [धान्य] yield [उत्पादन] ( 1.17 -1 ) compared to control. In field [शेत] demonstrations, 12.0 % increase in grain [धान्य] yield [उत्पादन] was recorded. Application of talc formulation reduced the incidence of soil [माती] borne diseases in vegetable crops ( 40-60 % ) and foot rot [फूट रॉट] in black pepper [काळी मिरी] ( 70-80 % ).

**Management of Gaushalas by ICAR**
```
# Deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] schedule
- Deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] should be started from the first week of calf [वासरू].
- A single oral dose [मात्रा] of 10 g piperazine adepate/ albendazole is recommended for the calves preferably in the first week of life to control neonatal ascariasis.
- Deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] should be done every month for first six months, thereafter once in three months.
- The deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] drugs and dose [मात्रा] should be consulted with qualified veterinary doctor time to time.
## Disposal of carcasses
Dead animals should be disposed immediately after death. The dead animals should never be thrown into stream or river and should not remain long in the shed [निवारा] as biting insects [चावणारे कीटक] and rodents can spread the disease [रोग]. The carcass should never be opened unless approved by a veterinarian [पशुवैद्यक]. The material like dung [शेण] and bedding [गादी] should be removed with much precaution otherwise there are chances of infection [संसर्ग]. The dead animal is either buried or burned. Deep burial is the most common method practiced while burning is the most sanitary method to dispose the carcass in the most effective manner.
## Mastitis [स्तनदाह] control
It is essential to regularly check the udders of milking [दूध काढणे] cow [गाय] for any injury, inflammation, pain [वेदना], redness or mastitis [स्तनदाह] to prevent the spread of mastitis [स्तनदाह] in the herd [पशूंचे झुंड]. Strip-cup test and modified California mastitis [स्तनदाह] test (MCMT) is used widely in field [शेत] condition for early detection [लवकर ओळख] and prompt treatment [उपचार]. Teat [थन] dipping before and after milking [दूध काढणे], drying [वाळवणे] up therapy using suitable antibiotics and other hygienic practices while milking [दूध काढणे] allows lesser incidence of udder [कास] problems.
## Reproductive health [आरोग्य]
Problems of the reproductive tract with cloudy, blood [रक्त] tinge, foul odor mucous [चिकट पदार्थ] discharge [स्त्राव] following abortion [गर्भपात] or calving [व्याने] should be carefully examined and treated with antibiotics or hormonal therapy. In case of problems of retained placenta [झार बाहेर न पडणे] more than 24-72 hours of calving [व्याने], manual removal of the placenta [झार] is not advised.
## Protocol for calf [वासरू] care
- Have a comprehensive herd [पशूंचे झुंड] health [आरोग्य] program in place.
- At the time of calving [व्याने], provide dry [कोरडे], sanitary maternity pens or paddocks.
- Provide an adequate volume of high-quality colostrum soon after birth.
```

- Green fodder [हिरवा चारा] - 25-30 kg should be given by mixing 20 kg of sorghum [ज्वारी]/maize [मका]/pearl millet [बाजरी]/wet grass family crops (kutti) and 5-10 kg of cowpea [चवळी]/lucerne [ल्युसेर्न]/berseem [बर्सीम].

- Give 35-40 liters of clean water [स्वच्छ पाणी] throughout the day.
- The milk production [दूध उत्पादन] period of the cow [गाय] should be 280 to 300 days, and the dry [कोरडे] period should be 45 to 60 days.

## Disposal of carcasses
Dead animals should be disposed immediately after death. The dead animals should never be thrown into stream or river and should not remain long in the shed [निवारा] as biting insects [चावणारे कीटक] and rodents can spread the disease [रोग]. The carcass should never be opened unless approved by a veterinarian [पशुवैद्यक]. The material like dung [शेण] and bedding [गादी] should be removed with much precaution otherwise there are chances of infection [संसर्ग]. The dead animal is either buried or burned. Deep burial is the most common method practiced while burning is the most sanitary method to dispose the carcass in the most effective manner.
## Mastitis [स्तनदाह] control
It is essential to regularly check the udders of milking [दूध काढणे] cow [गाय] for any injury, inflammation, pain [वेदना], redness or mastitis [स्तनदाह] to prevent the spread of mastitis [स्तनदाह] in the herd [पशूंचे झुंड]. Strip-cup test and modified California mastitis [स्तनदाह] test (MCMT) is used widely in field [शेत] condition for early detection [लवकर ओळख] and prompt treatment [उपचार]. Teat [थन] dipping before and after milking [दूध काढणे], drying [वाळवणे] up therapy using suitable antibiotics and other hygienic practices while milking [दूध काढणे] allows lesser incidence of udder [कास] problems.
## Reproductive health [आरोग्य]
Problems of the reproductive tract with cloudy, blood [रक्त] tinge, foul odor mucous [चिकट पदार्थ] discharge [स्त्राव] following abortion [गर्भपात] or calving [व्याने] should be carefully examined and treated with antibiotics or hormonal therapy. In case of problems of retained placenta [झार बाहेर न पडणे] more than 24-72 hours of calving [व्याने], manual removal of the placenta [झार] is not advised.
## Protocol for calf [वासरू] care
- Have a comprehensive herd [पशूंचे झुंड] health [आरोग्य] program in place.
- At the time of calving [व्याने], provide dry [कोरडे], sanitary maternity pens or paddocks.
- Provide an adequate volume of high-quality colostrum soon after birth.

# Maintaining hygiene [स्वच्छता] of animals as well as Gaushalas and disposal of waste
M L Kamboj, Saroj Rai, Subhash Chandra and Anjali Kumari ICAR- National Dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] Research Institute, Karnal
A clean shelter [आश्रयस्थान] increases the comfort level of animals and has a positive impact on the health [आरोग्य] of the animal. Proper hygienic conditions help to avoid bacterial, viral, and parasitic infections and related illnesses in animals. It is, therefore, of utmost importance that animals must be accommodated under most hygienic conditions.
## Shelter [आश्रयस्थान] sanitation protocol
The objective of sanitation is to properly clean and remove most of the germs and parasites along with dirt from animal houses so that remaining germs are less in number and possibly in a weak condition so as to be harmless under ordinary conditions. The presence of dung [शेण], urine [मूत्र], spilled milk [दूध], uterine and nasal discharge [नाकातून स्त्राव], feed residues etc. cause sanitation problems. Proper cleaning [साफसफाई] removes most of the germs and parasites along with the dirt. Abundant supply of water under pressure is the easiest and most effective means of cleaning [साफसफाई] animal sheds. Apart from that several sanitising solutions are also available commercially for use.
## Disinfection
It means destroying the cause of infection [संसर्ग]. Since the causative agents of many diseases are extremely small and may remain indefinitely in dust, cracks [भेगा] and crevices of buildings, disinfection must be carried out carefully to eradicate common enemies of life such as bacteria [जीवाणू], viruses, moulds and eggs [अंडी] of insects from contaminated premises. The nature of the surfaces will influence the efficacy of the disinfection. Rough, porous surfaces are harder to disinfect than smooth surfaces. Porous surfaces are also harder to clean than smooth surfaces. Porous surfaces will therefore have heavier soil [माती] loads after cleaning [साफसफाई], which further increase the difficulty of disinfection. A broad spectrum disinfectant with penetration enhancers should be used to disinfect gaushalas.

## अतिरिक्त रासायनिक खतांचा जमिनीतील सूक्ष्मजीवांवर परिणाम

रासायनिक खतांचा अतिवापर केल्यास जमिनीतील सूक्ष्मजीवांवर गंभीर दुष्परिणाम होतात. याबद्दल महत्त्वाची माहिती खालीलप्रमाणे:

### मुख्य दुष्परिणाम:

**१. जैविक समतोल बिघडतो:** गहन शेती पद्धती आणि कृषीरसायनांच्या वापरामुळे जमिनीतील जैविक समतोल विस्कळीत होतो. यामुळे मातीचे आरोग्य खालावते आणि जमीन "आजारी" होते.

**२. सुपीकता कमी होते:** अतिरिक्त रासायनिक खतांमुळे जमिनीची सुपीकता कमी होते आणि जैवविविधता नष्ट होते. निरोगी जमिनीत अब्जावधी विविध सूक्ष्मजीव असतात जे जमिनीला "जिवंत" ठेवतात - हे सूक्ष्मजीव कमी झाल्यास जमिनीची उत्पादनक्षमता घटते.

**३. पोषक तत्वांची हानी:** रासायनिक खतांच्या अतिवापरामुळे जमिनीतून पोषक तत्वांची हानी होते आणि भूजलाची गुणवत्ताही खालावते.

### उपाय आणि शिफारसी:

**१. जैविक खतांचा वापर करा:** रायझोबियम, अॅझोटोबॅक्टर, ट्रायकोडर्मा, मायकोरायझा यांसारख्या जैविक खतांचा वापर केल्यास रासायनिक खतांचा वापर २५-३०% पर्यंत कमी होतो.

**२. सेंद्रिय खत वापरा:** प्रति हेक्टर १० ते १५ टन सेंद्रिय खत वापरल्यास जमिनीतील सूक्ष्मजीवांची संख्या वाढते.

**३. पीक फेरपालट करा:** एकच पीक सतत घेण्याऐवजी पीक फेरपालट केल्यास जमिनीचे आरोग्य टिकून राहते.

**४. एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन:** रासायनिक खतांबरोबरच जैविक खते आणि कंपोस्ट यांचा संतुलित वापर केल्यास मृदा आरोग्य सुधारते.

**५. माती परीक्षण करा:** नियमित माती परीक्षण करून खतांचा योग्य प्रमाणातच वापर करा.

# Measures Related to the Management [व्यवस्थापन] of Chemical Herbicide [तणनाशक] Residues:
Considering the risk of increased herbicide [तणनाशक] residues in the future due to overuse of herbicides [तणनाशके], the following measures should be taken to prevent such residues from increasing in the soil [माती].
1. Use herbicides [तणनाशके] only in the recommended doses.
2. To prevent the increase of herbicide [तणनाशक] residues in the soil [माती], alternate the use of herbicides [तणनाशके] instead of using the same herbicide [तणनाशक] repeatedly. Use a pre-emergence herbicide [उगवणपूर्व तणनाशक] once, and the next time use a post-emergence herbicide [उगवण पश्चात तणनाशक] as recommended.
3. If crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट] is done instead of taking the same crop [पीक] repeatedly, and if the herbicide [तणनाशक] is changed alternatively, the amount of herbicide [तणनाशक] in the soil [माती] is reduced.

Soil health [मृदा आरोग्य] is the key to agricultural production [उत्पादन]. Soils are natural habitat for billions of diverse microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव] which serve as the ecological engineers to make soil [माती] as a "living" system. Healthy soils generally have balanced nutrient [पोषक घटक] levels and sufficient biological activity especially of microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव]. However, intensive cultivation with modern practices including application of agrochemicals [कृषीरसायने] have led to increased nutrient [पोषक घटक] loss from the soil [माती] and disturbed the soil [माती] biological equilibrium leading to deteriorated soil health [मृदा आरोग्य]. This has eventually made our soils "sick" which will ultimately lead to reduced fertility [प्रजननक्षमता].
Application of microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव] in agriculture [शेती] is well known. The microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव] like Rhizobium [रायझोबियम], Azospirillum Azotobacter, Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा], Bacillus thuringiensis [बॅसिलस थुरिंगिएन्सिस], blue green algae and arbuscular mycorrhizae [मायकोरायझा] have significant impacts in crop [पीक] production [उत्पादन] and protection. As deteriorating soil health [मृदा आरोग्य], changing climate [हवामान], new emerging diseases have become serious threats to agriculture [शेती], there is a need to look beyond the routine chemical intensive agriculture [शेती] and go for using green technologies. The global reports suggest that microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव] can play an important role in restoring soil health [मृदा आरोग्य], combating biotic and abiotic stresses under changing climate [हवामान] scenario.

# 11. Soil Health [मृदा आरोग्य] Testing
- To enhance soil health [मृदा आरोग्य] and optimize fertilizer use [खत वापर] while minimizing environmental impact [पर्यावरणीय परिणाम], it is crucial to assess the fertility [प्रजननक्षमता] and nutrient [पोषक घटक] status of the soil [माती] regularly. This evaluation [मूल्यांकन] provides valuable insights into the soil [माती]'s nutrient availability [पोषण मूल्य उपलब्धता], helping farmers make informed decisions on fertilizer application [खत देणे], thus promoting sustainable agricultural practices [कृषी पद्धती].
- Soil testing [माती परीक्षण] is an essential tool in this process, enabling the creation of a Soil Health Card [मृदा आरोग्य पत्रिका] for each farmer [शेतकरी]. The Soil Health Card [मृदा आरोग्य पत्रिका] serves as a personalized guide, offering a comprehensive analysis of the nutrient [पोषक घटक] profile of the soil [माती] and providing recommendations for nutrient management [अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन]. By identifying the exact requirements of the soil [माती], farmers can apply fertilizers in precise, targeted doses, avoiding excess or insufficient usage, which leads to cost savings and improved crop productivity [पीक उत्पादकता].

This will be tracked through integration of Soil Health [मृदा आरोग्य] Portal with the National Mission on Edible Oils - Oilseeds (NMEO-OS) portal for seamless data exchange. This integrated approach will create a more efficient and standardized system for soil health management [मृदा आरोग्य व्यवस्थापन] across the country.

# PREFACE
Indian Council of Agricultural Research [कृषी संशोधन] is the leader of agricultural research [कृषी संशोधन] in India developing a large number of technologies adopted by farmers and other stakeholders. This has led to increased crop productivity [पीक उत्पादकता] in almost all the crops so that demands of a growing population are met adequately. The growth [वाढ] in agricultural production [उत्पादन] in the last few decades has been accompanied by a sharp increase in the use of chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते], causing serious concern. Foremost among these concerns is the effect of excessive fertilizers on the quality of soil [माती] and ground water. As a consequence the soil health [मृदा आरोग्य] is compromised for productivity and over a period our soils are made sick with reduced fertility [प्रजननक्षमता] and eroded biodiversity [जैवविविधता].
The use of environmental friendly biofertilizers [जैव खते] can cut down the use of chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]. Biofetilizers are the products containing living cells of different types of microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव] that enrich the nutrient [पोषक घटक] quality of soil [माती]. Bacteria [जीवाणू], fungi and cyanobacteria [सायनोबॅक्टेरिया] (blue green algae) are considered as the potential candidates to be used as biofertilizers [जैव खते]. Most biofertilizers [जैव खते] belong to one of the following categories: nitrogen fixing [नत्र स्थिरीकरण]; phosphate, potash and zinc [झिंक] solubilizing and mobilizing, and plant growth [वाढ] promoting rhizobacteria [मुळाभोवतीचे जीवाणू]. The Gazette of India in its notification in April, 2014 also made provision for the production [उत्पादन] of microbial consortium [सूक्ष्मजिवांचा संघ]. It is economical to use biofertilizers [जैव खते] as they are a cheap source of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] when compared to chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]. Biofertilizers [जैव खते] in addition to different nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] also provide certain growth [वाढ] promoting substances like hormones, vitamins [जीवनसत्त्वे], and amino acids [अमिनो आम्ल] that improve the plant health [वनस्पती आरोग्य] and vigour.
Keeping pace with the biofertilizer [जैविक खत] industry, several Institutes of ICAR have developed biofertilizer [जैविक खत] technologies which have been validated under on-farm or multi-location trials. This compendium "ICAR Technologies: Biofertilizers [जैव खते] for Sustainable Crop Production [शाश्वत पीक उत्पादन]" is an intensive compilation and reflects the great efforts made by the scientists across various institutes to develop the technologies.

## वासरांचे जंतुनिर्मूलन (कृमिनाशक देणे) - योग्य पद्धत

वासरांमध्ये जंत (कृमी) नियंत्रण करणे हे त्यांच्या चांगल्या वाढीसाठी आणि आरोग्यासाठी खूप महत्त्वाचे आहे.

### कृमिनाशक कधी द्यावे (वेळापत्रक):

**पहिले सहा महिने:**
- **पहिल्या आठवड्यातच** कृमिनाशक देणे सुरू करावे
- पहिल्या सहा महिन्यांत **दर महिन्याला** एकदा कृमिनाशक द्यावे

**सहा महिन्यांनंतर:**
- **दर तीन महिन्यांनी** एकदा कृमिनाशक द्यावे

### औषध आणि मात्रा:

- नवजात वासरांसाठी **पायपेराझिन एडिपेट** किंवा **अल्बेंडाझोल** या औषधांची **१० ग्रॅम तोंडावाटे एकच मात्रा** देण्याची शिफारस केली जाते
- या औषधामुळे नवजात वासरांमधील एस्कॅरियासिस (जंतांचा प्रकार) नियंत्रणात राहतो

### महत्त्वाच्या सूचना:

1. **पशुवैद्यकांचा सल्ला घ्या** - कृमिनाशक औषध आणि मात्रा वेळोवेळी पशुवैद्यकांकडून निश्चित करून घ्यावी
2. **गोठ्याची स्वच्छता राखा** - शेण आणि पेंढा योग्य ठिकाणी ठेवावा, गोठा फिनाईलने साफ करावा
3. **वेगवेगळ्या वयाच्या जनावरांना वेगळे ठेवा** - लहान वासरांना मोठ्या जनावरांबरोबर मिसळू नये
4. **चरण्याच्या जागेची काळजी घ्या** - पाणी साचलेल्या जागांपासून जनावरांना दूर ठेवावे

### अतिरिक्त खबरदारी:

- वासरांना वेळोवेळी **लसीकरणही** करावे
- कृमिनाशक देण्यापूर्वी वासराचे वजन आणि वय लक्षात घ्यावे
- कोणत्याही आजाराची लक्षणे दिसल्यास त्वरित पशुवैद्यकांशी संपर्क साधावा

# Deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] schedule
- Deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] should be started from the first week of calf [वासरू].
- A single oral dose [मात्रा] of 10 g piperazine adepate/ albendazole is recommended for the calves preferably in the first week of life to control neonatal ascariasis.
- Deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] should be done every month for first six months, thereafter once in three months.
- The deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] drugs and dose [मात्रा] should be consulted with qualified veterinary doctor time to time.
## Disposal of carcasses
Dead animals should be disposed immediately after death. The dead animals should never be thrown into stream or river and should not remain long in the shed [निवारा] as biting insects [चावणारे कीटक] and rodents can spread the disease [रोग]. ## चुन्याचा वापर करून आम्लयुक्त जमीन कशी सुधारावी

आम्लयुक्त जमीन म्हणजे अशी जमीन ज्याचा सामू (pH) ६.५ पेक्षा कमी असतो. अशा जमिनीमध्ये पिकांची वाढ कमी होते आणि उत्पादनावर परिणाम होतो. चुन्याचा वापर करून जमिनीचा सामू वाढवून ती सुधारता येते.

### चुना वापरण्याची पद्धत

**१. माती परीक्षण करा:**
प्रथम आपल्या जमिनीची माती परीक्षण करून घ्या जेणेकरून सामू (pH) किती आहे हे समजेल. यावरून चुन्याची अचूक मात्रा ठरवता येते.

**२. कृषी चुना वापरा:**
- जमिनीचा सामू ६.० पेक्षा जास्त असेल तर प्रति हेक्टर २००-२५० किलो कृषी चुना (कॅल्शियम कार्बोनेट) वापरावा.
- सामू ६.० पेक्षा कमी असेल तर माती परीक्षणानुसार जास्त मात्रा लागू शकते.

**३. चुना वापरण्याची वेळ:**
- पेरणीपूर्वी किमान २-३ आठवडे आधी चुना जमिनीत मिसळावा.
- पावसाळ्यापूर्वी किंवा उन्हाळ्यात नांगरणीनंतर चुना टाकणे योग्य असते.

**४. चुना मिसळण्याची पद्धत:**
- चुना समान प्रमाणात शेतात पसरवा आणि वखर मारून जमिनीत चांगला मिसळून टाका.

## मिरची वाळवण्याच्या योग्य पद्धती

### १. पारंपरिक उन्हात वाळवणे

मिरची वाळवण्यासाठी फळे पूर्णपणे पिकून लाल झाल्यावर काढणी करावी. साधारण उन्हात वाळवताना मातीवर पसरवल्यास धूळ, माती इत्यादी लागून मिरचीचा रंग आणि दर्जा खराब होतो.

### २. सोलार ड्रायर (सौर वाळवण यंत्र) - सर्वोत्तम पद्धत

मिरचीचा रंग, चव आणि गुणवत्ता टिकवण्यासाठी **सोलार टनेल ड्रायर** वापरणे अत्यंत फायदेशीर आहे. या यंत्रामध्ये:

- हरितगृह परिणामामुळे आतील तापमान बाहेरील तापमानापेक्षा १० ते १५ अंश सेल्सियस जास्त राहते
- गरम हवा आणि सूर्यकिरणांमुळे ओलावा लवकर कमी होतो
- अल्ट्राव्हायोलेट किरणे आत शिरत नसल्याने **मिरचीचा रंग, चव आणि गुणवत्ता** चांगली टिकून राहते
- १०० किलो क्षमता असलेले ड्रायर उपलब्ध आहेत
- ड्रायर पूर्व-पश्चिम दिशेने बांधावा

### ३. मिनी सोलार टनेल ड्रायर

घरगुती वापरासाठी लहान सोलार ड्रायर (१० किलो क्षमता) उपयुक्त आहे. यामध्ये ५८ अंश सेल्सियसपर्यंत तापमान मिळते आणि लाल मिरची चांगल्या प्रकारे वाळवता येते. यंत्राचा आकार लहान असल्याने हाताळणे सोपे असते.

### ४. सोलार कॅबिनेट ड्रायर

यामध्ये उष्णता साठवण प्रणाली असते. सूर्यप्रकाश कमी झाल्यावरही सायंकाळी ५ नंतर आणखी २ तास गरम हवा मिळते, ज्यामुळे वाळवण्याचा वेळ वाचतो आणि **पारंपरिक पद्धतीपेक्षा गुणवत्ता, चव आणि रंग चांगला राहतो**.

# Harvesting [कापणी], post harvest management [कापणी व्यवस्थापन], and quality control
## HARVESTING [कापणी]
Plants are harvested for drying [वाळवणे] after 45-60 days of culture. The whole plant can be harvested three ways:
- the individual plant is untied or cut from the cultivation rope [दोरी] - this is commonly practiced in the multiple raft long-line or 'alul' and the hanging long-line
- both ends of the cultivation rope [दोरी] is untied from the stakes - this is practiced in fixed off-bottom or 'parasdas' method, and sometimes in the hanging long line.
- the whole single bamboo [बांबू] raft set up is brought to the shoreline and the seaweeds are untied or cut individually on land

# POST-HARVEST MANAGEMENT [काढणी पश्चात व्यवस्थापन]
Cleaning [साफसफाई] - clean the newly harvested seaweed to maintain a high quality product. Remove the following:
- non-Kappaphycus seaweeds
- sand
- plastic 'tie-tie'
- stones
- wood
- other foreign particles that adhere to the harvested crop [पीक]
Drying [वाळवणे] the harvested seaweeds - there are two methods of drying [वाळवणे] (Fig [अंजीर]. 16):
- ground level - mats, fish [मासे] net, or coconut [नारळ] leaves may be used; constantly turning the seaweeds will accelerate drying [वाळवणे]
- off-ground level - platform or hanging lines; this method will allow air to circulate more rapidly, thus shortening the drying [वाळवणे] period

आपल्या प्रश्नाबद्दल माहिती मिळवली आहे. आता मी आपल्याला **बियाणे व खत पेरणी यंत्राची (सीड कम फर्टिलायझर ड्रिल)** देखभाल कशी करावी याबद्दल माहिती देतो.

---

## बियाणे व खत पेरणी यंत्राची देखभाल कशी करावी

बियाणे व खत पेरणी यंत्र (सीड फर्टिलायझर ड्रिल) ही एक महत्त्वाची कृषी यंत्रसामग्री आहे जी बियाणे आणि खत एकत्रितपणे पेरण्यासाठी वापरली जाते. या यंत्राची योग्य देखभाल केल्यास ते जास्त काळ टिकते आणि चांगले काम करते.

### वापरापूर्वी देखभाल

- यंत्राच्या सर्व भागांची तपासणी करा आणि खात्री करा की ते घट्ट बसलेले आहेत.
- बियाणे पेटी आणि खत पेटी स्वच्छ करा जेणेकरून जुने बियाणे किंवा खत अडकलेले नसेल.
- सर्व फिरत्या भागांना वंगण (ग्रीस/तेल) लावा.
- साखळ्या आणि चाके यांची तपासणी करा.
- पेरणी नळ्या (फरो ओपनर) व्यवस्थित आहेत का पहा.

### वापरानंतर देखभाल

- प्रत्येक वापरानंतर यंत्र स्वच्छ पाण्याने धुवा आणि कोरडे करा.
- बियाणे पेटी आणि खत पेटीतील उरलेले बियाणे व खत काढून टाका.
- खत पेटी विशेष स्वच्छ करा कारण खतामुळे गंज लागू शकतो.
- सर्व धातूच्या भागांवर तेल लावा जेणेकरून गंज लागणार नाही.

### साठवणुकीची काळजी

- यंत्र झाकून ठेवा किंवा छपराखाली निवाऱ्यात ठेवा.
- ऊन, पाऊस आणि ओलाव्यापासून यंत्राचे संरक्षण करा.
- साठवणुकीपूर्वी सर्व फिरत्या भागांना वंगण लावा.
- टायर जमिनीपासून वर ठेवा किंवा हवेचा दाब योग्य ठेवा.

### नियमित तपासणी आणि दुरुस्ती

- बोल्ट, नट आणि पिन यांची नियमित तपासणी करा.
- खराब झालेले भाग लवकर बदला.
- बेअरिंग, बेल्ट आणि साखळ्या यांची झीज तपासा.
- सुट्या भागांसाठी अधिकृत विक्रेत्याशी संपर्क साधा.

### प्रशिक्षण घ्या

शासनामार्फत कृषी यंत्रसामग्रीच्या देखभाल आणि दुरुस्तीसाठी **मोफत प्रशिक्षण कार्यक्रम** उपलब्ध आहेत. यामध्ये सुधारित कृषी यंत्रसामग्रीची निवड, चालवणे, सुरक्षितता आणि देखभाल याबद्दल ६ आठवड्यांचे प्रशिक्षण दिले जाते.

---

**स्रोत: कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण उप-अभियान मार्गदर्शक तत्त्वे**

आपल्याला या यंत्रासाठी शासकीय अनुदान योजनांबद्दल माहिती हवी असल्यास किंवा जवळच्या कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटरची (सीएचसी) माहिती हवी असल्यास मला सांगा.

- All the roofs, drainage channels and water collection tanks should be properly cleaned before rainy season so to avoid any type of contamination to the harvested water. The collection tanks shall be kept covered.

- Any type of exotic fish [मासे] should not be released in to open water systems. Proper measures should be adopted even to control accidental escape.

## तणनाशक फवारणीसाठी पाठीवरील फवारणी यंत्राचे मोजमाप (कॅलिब्रेशन) कसे करावे

**कॅलिब्रेशन म्हणजे काय?**

कॅलिब्रेशन म्हणजे फवारणी करण्यापूर्वी विशिष्ट क्षेत्रावर विशिष्ट दाबाखाली किती द्रावण फवारले जाते याची तपासणी करणे. यामुळे संपूर्ण शेतात एकसारखी फवारणी होते आणि तणनाशकाचा योग्य वापर होतो.

**कॅलिब्रेशनची पद्धत:**

1. **नोझल निवडा** – तणनाशक फवारणीसाठी फ्लॅट फॅन किंवा फ्लड जेट नोझल वापरा कारण यामुळे सर्वत्र एकसारखी फवारणी होते आणि कमी दाबाने फवारणी होऊन शेजारच्या पिकांवर द्रावण उडत नाही.

2. **ठराविक क्षेत्र मोजा** – एक ठराविक क्षेत्र (उदा. १० x १० मीटर = १०० चौ. मीटर) आखून घ्या.

3. **पंपामध्ये पाणी भरा** – पंपामध्ये ठराविक प्रमाणात स्वच्छ पाणी भरा आणि त्याची नोंद करा.

4. **एकसमान दाबाने फवारणी करा** – त्या ठराविक क्षेत्रावर नेहमीच्या वेगाने आणि एकसमान दाबाने फवारणी करा.

5. **वापरलेले पाणी मोजा** – फवारणीनंतर किती पाणी वापरले ते मोजा.

6. **प्रति हेक्टर गणना करा** – वापरलेल्या पाण्याच्या प्रमाणावरून प्रति हेक्टर किती द्रावण लागेल याची गणना करा.

**महत्त्वाच्या सूचना:**

- फवारणी करताना सर्वत्र एकसमान दाब ठेवा.
- फवारणी करताना द्रावण वेळोवेळी हलवत राहा जेणेकरून तणनाशक पंपाच्या तळाशी बसणार नाही.
- तणनाशक फवारणीनंतर संपूर्ण पंप (नोझलसह) साबणाच्या पाण्याने २-३ वेळा आणि नंतर स्वच्छ पाण्याने २-३ वेळा धुवा.
- फवारणी करताना रबरी हातमोजे घाला आणि फवारणीनंतर हात साबणाने स्वच्छ धुवा.

**स्रोत: पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ**

आपल्याला तणनाशक फवारणीच्या वेळेबद्दल किंवा विशिष्ट पिकासाठी शिफारस केलेल्या तणनाशकांबद्दल अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का?

## जास्त दूध देणाऱ्या गायींमध्ये स्तनदाह (मॅस्टायटिस) कसा टाळावा

स्तनदाह हा गायींच्या कासेला होणारा एक सामान्य पण गंभीर आजार आहे, जो विशेषतः जास्त दूध देणाऱ्या गायींमध्ये आढळतो. योग्य काळजी घेतल्यास हा आजार टाळता येतो.

### स्तनदाह टाळण्यासाठी प्रतिबंधात्मक उपाय:

**१. दूध काढताना स्वच्छता राखणे:**
- दूध काढण्यापूर्वी आणि नंतर थनांना (टीट डिपिंग) जंतुनाशक द्रावणात बुडवा.
- दूध काढण्यापूर्वी हात स्वच्छ धुवा आणि गायीची कास स्वच्छ कापडाने पुसा.
- दूध काढण्याची वेळ नियमित ठेवा.

**२. नियमित तपासणी:**
- दूध काढणाऱ्या गायींच्या कासेची नियमितपणे तपासणी करा - जखम, सूज, वेदना किंवा लालसरपणा आहे का ते पहा.
- **कॅलिफोर्निया मॅस्टायटिस टेस्ट (सीएमटी)** महिन्यातून किमान एकदा सर्व गायींवर करा. या चाचणीमुळे लपलेला स्तनदाह लवकर ओळखता येतो.
- स्ट्रिप-कप चाचणी वापरून दुधात बदल आहे का ते तपासा.

**३. आटवणीच्या काळातील उपचार (ड्राय पीरियड थेरपी):**
- गाय आटवण्याच्या वेळी पशुवैद्यकाच्या सल्ल्याने योग्य प्रतिजैविक औषधांचा वापर करा. यामुळे पुढील वेतातील स्तनदाहाची शक्यता कमी होते.

**४. गोठ्याची स्वच्छता:**
- गोठा कोरडा आणि स्वच्छ ठेवा.
- अंथरूण नियमितपणे बदला.
- चावणाऱ्या कीटकांपासून संरक्षण करा कारण ते संसर्ग पसरवू शकतात.

**५. योग्य आहार व्यवस्थापन:**
- संतुलित आहार द्या ज्यात प्रथिने, ऊर्जा, खनिजे आणि जीवनसत्त्वे असतील.
- स्वच्छ पाण्याची नेहमी उपलब्धता ठेवा.
- रोगप्रतिकारशक्ती वाढवण्यासाठी शतावरी (३० ग्रॅम सकाळी आणि संध्याकाळी) देता येते.

**६. आजारी गायींची काळजी:**
- स्तनदाह झालेल्या गायीचे दूध वेगळे काढा आणि इतर गायींपासून तिला दूर ठेवा.
- पशुवैद्यकाचा सल्ला घेऊन त्वरित उपचार सुरू करा.

**स्रोत: ICAR गौशाला व्यवस्थापन मार्गदर्शिका**

तुमच्या गायींमध्ये सध्या स्तनदाहाची कोणती लक्षणे दिसत आहेत का? किंवा तुम्हाला दुधाचे उत्पादन वाढवण्याबद्दल अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का?

- Deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] should be done every month for first six months, thereafter once in three months.

## Disposal of carcasses
Dead animals should be disposed immediately after death. The dead animals should never be thrown into stream or river and should not remain long in the shed [निवारा] as biting insects [चावणारे कीटक] and rodents can spread the disease [रोग]. The carcass should never be opened unless approved by a veterinarian [पशुवैद्यक]. The material like dung [शेण] and bedding [गादी] should be removed with much precaution otherwise there are chances of infection [संसर्ग]. The dead animal is either buried or burned. Deep burial is the most common method practiced while burning is the most sanitary method to dispose the carcass in the most effective manner.
## Mastitis [स्तनदाह] control
It is essential to regularly check the udders of milking [दूध काढणे] cow [गाय] for any injury, inflammation, pain [वेदना], redness or mastitis [स्तनदाह] to prevent the spread of mastitis [स्तनदाह] in the herd [पशूंचे झुंड]. Strip-cup test and modified California mastitis [स्तनदाह] test (MCMT) is used widely in field [शेत] condition for early detection [लवकर ओळख] and prompt treatment [उपचार]. Teat [थन] dipping before and after milking [दूध काढणे], drying [वाळवणे] up therapy using suitable antibiotics and other hygienic practices while milking [दूध काढणे] allows lesser incidence of udder [कास] problems.
## Reproductive health [आरोग्य]
Problems of the reproductive tract with cloudy, blood [रक्त] tinge, foul odor mucous [चिकट पदार्थ] discharge [स्त्राव] following abortion [गर्भपात] or calving [व्याने] should be carefully examined and treated with antibiotics or hormonal therapy. In case of problems of retained placenta [झार बाहेर न पडणे] more than 24-72 hours of calving [व्याने], manual removal of the placenta [झार] is not advised.

- At the time of calving [व्याने], provide dry [कोरडे], sanitary maternity pens or paddocks.
- Provide an adequate volume of high-quality colostrum soon after birth.

# Feed management [आहार व्यवस्थापन]
Cattle [गाय वर्ग] require a balance of protein [प्रथिने], energy, water, minerals [खनिजे], and vitamins [जीवनसत्त्वे] for optimal health [आरोग्य] and production [उत्पादन], called a ration. Feed is separated into two classes:

b. Concentrates [दाणेदार खाद्य]—Feeds low in fiber and high in digestible nutrients [पोषक तत्वे], such as grains [धान्ये], cottonseed meal [जेवण], wheat bran [गव्हाचा भुसा], and soybean [सोयाबीन] meal [जेवण].
Animals should have access to feed and water on a daily basis, in a consistent manner, on a regular schedule, and according to their specific requirements. Dehorn calves of horned breeds- Dehorning or disbudding [अनावश्यक कळ्या काढणे] is performed to avoid injury to herdmates and personnel, reduce feeder space requirements, and increase handling ease. Cattle [गाय वर्ग] with the population of more than 190 million is a predominant species [प्रजाती] of farm animals in India. The cow [गाय] is treated as the most pious and sanctified animal in India. Slaughter of cows is banned under the provisions of Indian constitution due to which there are a large number of (around 5.3 million) unproductive and aged cows. Management [व्यवस्थापन] of these cattle [गाय वर्ग] is a challenge and gaushalas have come forward to accept it. Presently, more than five thousand gaushalas are functioning as shelter [आश्रयस्थान] for such cows. The management [व्यवस्थापन] of these gaushalas is by and large on traditional lines rather than on scientific basis. It is imperative for these gaushalas to keep cows in such a way that they may be free from hunger, fear, distress and diseases.
The Animal Science Division [विभाग] of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research [कृषी संशोधन] (ICAR) has prepared a Manual on Management [व्यवस्थापन] of Gaushalas, which will significantly help in capacity building of gaushala staff for scientific rearing of cows. This manual provides information on housing [निवास व्यवस्था], sanitation, feeding [खाऊ घालणे], breeding [प्रजनन] and health [आरोग्य] aspects of cattle [गाय वर्ग] management [व्यवस्थापन], which will certainly help in transforming gaushalas for better upkeep of cows and their progeny [संतती].
I appreciate the sincere efforts of Animal Science Division [विभाग] in preparation, compilation and editing of this manual, which will be valuable to all gaushalas and the livestock [पशुधन] keepers.

answer:
उपलब्ध माहितीनुसार म्हशींमधील दुधाळ ताप (मिल्क फीव्हर) बद्दल विशिष्ट उपचार माहिती सध्या उपलब्ध नाही. तथापि, मी आपल्याला कॅल्शियमच्या कमतरतेशी संबंधित एक समान आजार आणि त्यावरील उपचारांबद्दल माहिती देतो जी उपयोगी असू शकते.

**दुधाळ ताप (मिल्क फीव्हर) म्हणजे काय?**

दुधाळ ताप हा म्हशी आणि गायींमध्ये व्यायल्यानंतर होणारा एक आजार आहे जो रक्तातील कॅल्शियमच्या कमतरतेमुळे होतो. हा आजार सामान्यतः जास्त दूध देणाऱ्या जनावरांमध्ये व्यायल्यानंतर 24 ते 72 तासांच्या आत दिसून येतो.

**कॅल्शियमच्या कमतरतेशी संबंधित उपचार:**

कृषी विद्यापीठातील माहितीनुसार, ऑक्झॅलिक अॅसिड विषबाधेमध्ये (जी रक्तातील कॅल्शियमच्या कमतरतेस कारणीभूत होते) खालील उपचार सुचवले आहेत:
- **पशुवैद्यकाकडून कॅल्शियमचे इंजेक्शन देणे** - हे सर्वात प्रभावी उपचार आहे
- **चुन्याचे पाणी** - 1 किलो कळीचा चुना 10 लिटर पाण्यात विरघळवून ठेवा आणि दर आठ तासांनी 1 लिटर द्या

**प्रतिबंधात्मक उपाय:**

- व्यायल्यानंतर जनावरांना योग्य आहार द्या - 1 किलो बाजरी, 500 ग्रॅम मेथी, 250 ग्रॅम गूळ, 100 ग्रॅम खोबरं, 100 ग्रॅम तेल, 50 ग्रॅम मीठ, 20 ग्रॅम ओवा, इत्यादी शिजवून 2-3 दिवस द्या
- नियमित खनिज मिश्रण आहारात समाविष्ट करा
- व्यायल्यानंतर 60 ते 90 दिवसांच्या आत गायी-म्हशी गाभण करा

**महत्त्वाची सूचना:**

दुधाळ ताप हा आणीबाणीचा आजार आहे. **तात्काळ जवळच्या पशुवैद्यकाशी संपर्क साधा** कारण वेळीच उपचार न मिळाल्यास जनावराचा मृत्यू होऊ शकतो.

# INTRODUCTION
Livestock farming [पशुपालन] is an integral part of Indian agriculture [शेती]. It is likely to be the instrument of future growth [वाढ] and development of this sector. Proper management [व्यवस्थापन] of the huge livestock [पशुधन] resources the country has, is essential to derive the targeted benefits from them. In this direction ICAR has already identified and registered 199 livestock [पशुधन] breeds, which are being conserved and further improved.
However, livestock productivity [पशुधन उत्पादकता] is adversely affected by various animal diseases, some of them being zoonotic in nature. Occurrence of diseases causes heavy economic loss in terms of livestock health [पशुधन आरोग्य] vis-a-vis production [उत्पादन] and has serious impact on export [निर्यात] of livestock [पशुधन] products including germplasm [आनुवंशिक द्रव्य]. The outbreaks of Foot-and-Mouth disease [रोग] and haemorrhagic septicaemia in cattle [गाय वर्ग] and buffaloes; PPR, goatpox, sheeppox, and orf in goats and sheep [मेंढी]; classical swine fever [क्लासिकल स्वाइन फीव्हर] in pigs; Newcastle disease [रोग], infectious bursal disease [रोग] and highly pathogenic avian influenza in poultry [कुक्कुट] have underlined the adverse impact of these diseases on livestock [पशुधन] and poultry [कुक्कुट] productivity.
The most effective way to overcome the loss from diseases and increase livestock productivity [पशुधन उत्पादकता] is through prevention [प्रतिबंध] of diseases using vaccines. The Animal Science institutes of ICAR have made significant contributions in control of major livestock [पशुधन] and poultry [कुक्कुट] diseases through development of several vaccines against them.

# INTRODUCTION
Livestock farming [पशुपालन] is an integral part of Indian agriculture [शेती]. It is likely to be the instrument of future growth [वाढ] and development of this sector. The country currently hosts 536 million livestock [पशुधन] and is the world's largest producer of milk [दूध] with 187.7 million tonnes per year with an annual growth [वाढ] of 6.5 % (Annual Report 2018-19, NDDB). Significant increase in milk production [दूध उत्पादन] popularly known as "White Revolution [धवल क्रांती]' has provided income security to the dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] farmers and ensured milk [दूध] availability to a great majority of the population, thereby supplementing the efforts towards nutritional security [पोषण सुरक्षा] in the country. A third dimension of livestock farming [पशुपालन] is supply of cow dung [शेण] for enriching soil health [मृदा आरोग्य], thereby enhancing and sustaining crop productivity [पीक उत्पादकता]. Proper management [व्यवस्थापन] of the huge livestock [पशुधन] resources the country has, is essential to derive the targeted benefits from them. In this direction ICAR has already identified and registered 199 livestock [पशुधन] breeds, which are being conserved and further improved.
However, livestock productivity [पशुधन उत्पादकता] is adversely affected by various animal diseases, some of them being zoonotic in nature. Occurrence of diseases causes heavy economic loss in terms of livestock health [पशुधन आरोग्य] vis-a-vis production [उत्पादन] and has serious impact on export [निर्यात] of livestock [पशुधन] products including germplasm [आनुवंशिक द्रव्य]. The outbreaks of Foot-and-Mouth disease [रोग] and haemorrhagic septicaemia in cattle [गाय वर्ग] and buffaloes; PPR, goatpox, sheeppox, and orf in goats and sheep [मेंढी]; classical swine fever [क्लासिकल स्वाइन फीव्हर] in pigs; Newcastle disease [रोग], infectious bursal disease [रोग] and highly pathogenic avian influenza in poultry [कुक्कुट] have underlined the adverse impact of these diseases on livestock [पशुधन] and poultry [कुक्कुट] productivity.
The most effective way to overcome the loss from diseases and increase livestock productivity [पशुधन उत्पादकता] is through prevention [प्रतिबंध] of diseases using vaccines. The Animal Science institutes of ICAR have made significant contributions in control of major livestock [पशुधन] and poultry [कुक्कुट] diseases through development of several vaccines against them.

# Practices for feeding [खाऊ घालणे] of heifers and cows
- Feed according to recommended feeding [खाऊ घालणे] standards (ICAR. 2013. Nutrient [पोषक घटक] Requirements of Cattle [गाय वर्ग] and Buffalo [म्हैस]). The nutritional management [व्यवस्थापन] of heifers requires a systematic approach to meet growth [वाढ] targets as nutrition [पोषण] and growth [वाढ] rate affect age of first calving [व्याने] and lifetime productivity. Ensure the composition of diets reflects production [उत्पादन] level, reproductive stage [प्रजनन अवस्था], body size, housing [निवास व्यवस्था] and weather [वातावरण] conditions.
- Test nutrient [पोषक घटक] content of feed ingredients periodically by consulting an animal nutritionist/dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] expert from a local agricultural/veterinary university/ Krishi Vigyan Kendras (Farm science Centres at district [जिल्हा] level).
- Ensure all rations have been balanced and that all feed components used in the ration are of good quality and free of spoilage.
- Where a change of feed is needed it should be introduced gradually, e.g. over a 7 - 10 day period. Abrupt changes in diet should be avoided.
- When increasing concentrates [दाणेदार खाद्य], do so gradually ( 0.5 to 0.7 kg / head / day) according to appetite [भूक].
- Provide fresh feed to the cows daily. Keep a consistent feeding [खाऊ घालणे] schedule, provide adequate feed manger access time, and ensure continuous access by pushing up feed in the feed manger.
- Ensure that feed surfaces are smooth and not more than approximately 4-6 inches higher than the standing area. Feed can be served at ground level also.
- Most feeding [खाऊ घालणे] activity occurs around the time of fresh feed delivery and when cows return from milking [दूध काढणे]. Provide adequate linear feeding [खाऊ घालणे] space ( 60 cm / cow [गाय]) to ensure that dominant cows cannot restrict access to feeding [खाऊ घालणे] areas.

# Deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] schedule
- Deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] should be started from the first week of calf [वासरू].
- A single oral dose [मात्रा] of 10 g piperazine adepate/ albendazole is recommended for the calves preferably in the first week of life to control neonatal ascariasis.
- Deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] should be done every month for first six months, thereafter once in three months.
- The deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] drugs and dose [मात्रा] should be consulted with qualified veterinary doctor time to time.
## Disposal of carcasses
Dead animals should be disposed immediately after death. The dead animals should never be thrown into stream or river and should not remain long in the shed [निवारा] as biting insects [चावणारे कीटक] and rodents can spread the disease [रोग]. The carcass should never be opened unless approved by a veterinarian [पशुवैद्यक]. The material like dung [शेण] and bedding [गादी] should be removed with much precaution otherwise there are chances of infection [संसर्ग]. The dead animal is either buried or burned. Deep burial is the most common method practiced while burning is the most sanitary method to dispose the carcass in the most effective manner.
## Mastitis [स्तनदाह] control
It is essential to regularly check the udders of milking [दूध काढणे] cow [गाय] for any injury, inflammation, pain [वेदना], redness or mastitis [स्तनदाह] to prevent the spread of mastitis [स्तनदाह] in the herd [पशूंचे झुंड]. Strip-cup test and modified California mastitis [स्तनदाह] test (MCMT) is used widely in field [शेत] condition for early detection [लवकर ओळख] and prompt treatment [उपचार]. Teat [थन] dipping before and after milking [दूध काढणे], drying [वाळवणे] up therapy using suitable antibiotics and other hygienic practices while milking [दूध काढणे] allows lesser incidence of udder [कास] problems.
## Reproductive health [आरोग्य]
Problems of the reproductive tract with cloudy, blood [रक्त] tinge, foul odor mucous [चिकट पदार्थ] discharge [स्त्राव] following abortion [गर्भपात] or calving [व्याने] should be carefully examined and treated with antibiotics or hormonal therapy. In case of problems of retained placenta [झार बाहेर न पडणे] more than 24-72 hours of calving [व्याने], manual removal of the placenta [झार] is not advised.
## Protocol for calf [वासरू] care
- Have a comprehensive herd [पशूंचे झुंड] health [आरोग्य] program in place.
- At the time of calving [व्याने], provide dry [कोरडे], sanitary maternity pens or paddocks.
- Provide an adequate volume of high-quality colostrum soon after birth.
